verdict.rationale: Steel is a cloud service that handles user session data, so a data-use or no-training policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no training opt-out, no data-use policy and no statement that customer data is excluded from model training. Self-hosting via the open-source Docker image and bring-your-own proxies are adjacent controls or user-side arrangements, not a documented no-training guarantee, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
